thesis: First Busey (Nasdaq: BUSE), Midwest regional bank holding, about 18.6B assets after the March 2025 CrossFirst Bankshares merger. Q3 2026 release (8-K 0000314489-26-000066) and 10-Q (0000314489-26-000070, filed 2026-11-05). Q3 net income 55.8M, diluted EPS 0.61 (adjusted 0.63) versus 63.2M in Q2 and 57.1M in Q3 2025; NIM 3.58% (adjusted 3.46%); efficiency ratio 54.4%; ROTCE 12.93%; CET1 12.47%, total capital 16.10%; tangible book value per share 19.37 (down from 20.40 in Q2 on buybacks and a lower AOCI, AOCI -241.9M); 188.4M repurchased in 2026 (80.26M shares on 2026-11-05 versus 88.41M a year earlier). Credit: nonaccrual 80.9M (62.8M in Q2), NPAs 0.45% of assets, ACL 164.3M = 1.28% of portfolio loans, Q3 net charge-offs 0.35% annualized, classified assets 244.9M (+83.8M year over year); one 37.6M Central region commercial relationship went nonaccrual with a 10.0M charge-off. Loans fell to 12.82B (about 65M lender finance moved to held for sale), deposits rose to 15.54B, loan to deposit 82.5%. Valuation at 28.87 (close 2026-11-13): price to tangible book 1.49x, price to common book about 1.14x; TTM net income 229.8M (FY2025 135.3M + 9M26 169.0M - 9M25 74.5M) less about 18.4M preferred dividends (222.75M at 8.25%, my estimate) gives about 211M to common, about 11x on period-end shares; dividend 1.04 annualized = 3.6% yield. Market view: a bank earning low-teens ROTCE priced under 1.5x tangible book with a credit scare; evidence for: strong capital, large buybacks, falling funding cost trend; the price gap closes if classified assets stop rising.
counterthesis: Credit signals are worsening: classified assets rose 83.8M in a year to 244.9M, nonaccrual rose 18M in one quarter, the provision quadrupled to 9.6M and a single relationship needed a 10.0M charge-off, which can mean more hidden weakness in the Central region and the CrossFirst book acquired in 2025. CRE is 41% of loans (office share not disclosed). Loan balances shrank and NIM fell 14 basis points from Q2, so earnings are drifting down (EPS 0.61 versus 0.63 estimate 0.67 in a secondary source). Tangible book fell about 5% in one quarter because 60M was repurchased above tangible book; heavy buybacks (188M year to date, about 8% of shares) reduce capital cushion if credit deteriorates. Nine month and FY2025 earnings include merger charges and restructuring (13.4M), so TTM is not clean. The TTM multiple uses an estimated preferred dividend and period-end shares. Peers and own history of P/TBV not compared; MD&A, loan note, deposit insurance and 10-K not read.
invalidation: Thesis fails if nonaccrual loans and classified assets keep rising for another quarter, net charge-offs exceed about 0.5% annualized, CET1 falls toward 11%, NIM falls below about 3.4% or ROTCE drops under 11%.
